prompts.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Wide 16:9 cinematic hero banner composition. Rain-cleared San Francisco/Oakland industrial rooftop deck at dusk, open sky, exterior environment, no interior lobby or apartment.

[FOCAL SUBJECT]
Full-body male figure anchored at the left vertical third, head-to-toe product-readable scale occupying approximately 28% of frame width. Wearing SG-009 Sherpa Jacket: matte black outer shell construction, thick cream-white sherpa pile lining visible at open collar and cuffs, red embroidered rose graphic centered on left chest panel, utility cargo pockets at hip. SG-007 Signature Beanie pulled low: forest-green ribbed knit with folded cuff, rectangular rubber rose-patch badge on front cuff showing two red roses with green stems rising from a cloud motif on a charcoal backing. Stance relaxed-confident, hands resting at sides or one pocket, body at three-quarter angle toward camera, face neutral and direct, neutral medium-warm skin tone, no retouching, no orange-tan cast, no doll-like smoothing.

[TYPOGRAPHY]
Freestanding civic sign sculpture placed at right third of frame, grounded on the rain-damp board-formed concrete deck surface. The sculpture reads the exact single unsplit wordmark "SkyyRose" in its full ornate script font with the copper rose bloom integrated at the terminus of the final letter — never separated, never split into two words, never reduced to a flat sticker or wall plaque. The sign has real physical presence: rose-gold and aged copper patina on cast letterforms approximately 90cm tall, mounted on a brushed-steel rectangular base plate bolted to the concrete, visible base contact shadow where the plate meets the wet deck, the damp floor carries a distorted rose-gold reflection of the letterforms below the base. The copper rose at the wordmark end catches the warm 3200K edge light with specular highlights on petal edges. The sculpture partially occludes the distant background through its negative spaces, confirming three-dimensional solidity. No halo, no floating, no pasted composite feel, no wall mounting, no lobby context.

[COMPOSITION]
Strong horizontal cinematic flow. Figure at left third as primary anchor, SkyyRose sculpture at right third as secondary anchor, mid-frame center breathes with damp concrete deck surface and the reflective puddle plane between them. Foreground depth: shallow rain puddle at extreme lower-left corner catching distorted amber bridge light, adds foreground layer. Midground: board-formed concrete deck surface with visible form-tie holes, wet sheen, dark weathered black steel railing at frame edge. Background: marine fog bank rolling in at 7000K blue-hour color, distant industrial cranes silhouetted in mid-distance, suspension bridge cable lights glowing amber-orange at 3000K through fog, bokeh point-lights of port infrastructure. Eye moves left-to-right from figure face → jacket rose emblem → concrete deck reflection plane → SkyyRose sculpture → bridge lights beyond. Clear foreground/midground/background depth separation.

[ATMOSPHERE]
West Coast industrial luxury. Post-rain air, damp concrete smell implied through visual texture. Marine fog diffuses the far background into a cool blue-grey atmospheric haze at 7000K. Warm amber bridge lights and the sculpture's edge light cut through the fog as motivated practical sources. Mood: confident restraint, cinematic grit, refined not precious. Deep open blacks in the jacket shell and deck shadows — shadow detail present but not crushed flat.

[LIGHTING]
Primary key: three-quarter back rim at 45° camera-right, hard direct strobe at 3200K, raking across the figure's right shoulder and the SkyyRose sculpture's letterform edges simultaneously, creating sharp-edged shadows on the concrete deck surface behind both subjects. Secondary fill: large softbox diffusion at 45° camera-left, 5500K daylight neutral, low intensity — opens left-side shadow on figure's face to reveal neutral skin tone without eliminating depth. Background motivated practical light: distant bridge suspension cables and port crane work lights at 3000K warm amber glowing through 7000K marine fog, creating atmospheric depth separation. Deck reflection: the rain-wet concrete carries elongated warm-amber reflections of the sculpture base and the bridge lights, rendered as distorted streaks not mirror-perfect pools. Shadow behavior: sharp-edged contact shadow at base of SkyyRose sculpture base plate, soft falloff with gradient transition on figure's ground shadow extending toward center frame, deep shadow side on figure's left with selective fill preserving jacket texture.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 35mm natural focal length, aperture f/2.8, shallow-to-mid depth of field — figure and sculpture both in sharp focus as co-equal subjects, background bridge lights and crane silhouettes fall into soft bokeh at approximately f/2.8 separation. Anamorphic feel: subtle horizontal lens breathing, faint anamorphic oval bokeh on background point-lights. Camera height: approximately sternum level of figure, slight upward tilt — gives figure and sculpture civic authority without heroic distortion. Restrained film grain at ISO 1600 equivalent, visible in shadow regions, not applied as uniform filter.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Three dominant tones: deep matte black (jacket shell, deck shadow, steel railing), rose-gold and aged copper (SkyyRose sculpture letterforms and rose bloom), cool blue-grey marine fog (background atmosphere at 7000K). Accent: warm amber-orange bridge cable glow at 3000K cutting through fog. Cream-white sherpa lining provides the single high-value light accent on figure. Red rose emblem on jacket chest: saturated crimson, small and precise, not competing with sculpture. Overall: cool-dominant background, warm-dominant foreground practical light, deep tonal range with rich blacks that retain surface texture.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Peter Lindbergh, Erwin Olaf, and Jamie Hawkesworth. Cinematic editorial fashion photography with industrial environmental authority. Lindbergh's neutral skin and deep shadow restraint, Olaf's precise compositional geometry and civic-scale prop presence, Hawkesworth's damp-air atmospheric texture and unglamourized urban realism.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Magazine campaign quality. Ultra-sharp on figure and sculpture at primary focal plane. Hyper-realistic material rendering: sherpa pile texture, matte nylon shell, board-formed concrete surface with form-tie voids, wet concrete sheen, rose-gold metal patina with specular highlights on letterform ridges, copper rose petal micro-detail. Wide cinematic depth. No HDR processing. No oversaturation. No synthetic stock-photo feel.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no asymmetric eyes,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no warped product label text, no garbled letters, no fake brand names,
no melted typography, no doubled labels, no fictional logos,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no interior lobby, no apartment setting, no wall plaque mounting, no skyline wallpaper backdrop,
no pasted halo around sculpture, no floating letterforms, no split wordmark,
no wordmark broken into two separate pieces, no missing copper rose from wordmark,
no rose omitted or separated from the SkyyRose lettering,
no flat sticker decal treatment of the sculpture, no 2D appliqué look,
no symmetric dead-center framing, no missing base contact shadow,
no missing floor reflection under sculpture, no sculpture floating above deck surface,
no interior window view substituting for exterior rooftop environment,
no generic cityscape wallpaper in background, no clean studio backdrop substituting for industrial rooftop.
